room.title: Room sensors, PID and morning comfort
room.description: Select physical temperature sensors. Choose manual gains or automatic tuning independently for this room. Morning time means the desired arrival time, not the time to switch the heater on.

error.invalid_config: Check system settings. PWM must cover minimum on and off times; targets must be below the safety limit.
